s01: Good morning, my friend! (pause) Yesterday we got ready for school. (pause) Today we sing songs. (pause) And we listen to stories!
veg: First, let us visit a garden full of vegetables. (pause) Let us meet some vegetables! (pause) Tap each one. (pause) Say its name with me.
veg-1: Pechay. (pause) It has big green leaves!
veg-2: Bawang. (pause) In English, garlic. (pause) It is white!
veg-3: Luya. (pause) In English, ginger. (pause) It is brown and bumpy!
song: Bawang and luya are in a famous song! (pause) Look at this little house. (pause) It is a bahay kubo. (pause) It has a big garden! (pause) Let us sing about it. (pause) Tap a line, or tap the big button to sing it all.
song-3: Singkamas at talong, sigarilyas at mani,
find-veg: What a lovely song! Now, can you find the vegetables? (pause) Can you find the vegetables? (pause) Listen. (pause) Then tap!
find-veg-q1: Where is the garlic? The bawang?
find-veg-q2: Where is the ginger? The luya?
find-veg-q3: Where is the pechay? The one with green leaves?
move: Great finding! Now let us sing with our whole body. (pause) Please stand up! (pause) Let us sing and move. (pause) Touch each part of your body with me!
t1: You sang and moved! Now sit down. It is story time. (pause) Story time! (pause) This is Turtle. (pause) And this is Monkey. (pause) One day, they find a banana plant. (pause) They cut it in two. (pause) Monkey takes the top. (pause) Turtle takes the bottom, with the roots.
t2: Monkey has the leaves. Turtle has the roots. What happens next? (pause) Monkey laughs at Turtle. (pause) Ha ha! My part has big leaves! (pause) But Turtle plants her part in the ground. (pause) She waters it every day.
t-mid: Turtle works hard every day. (pause) Quick question!
t-mid-q1: Who planted the banana plant and watered it every day?
t-mid-q1-yes: Yes! Turtle planted it and watered it. (pause) Let us see what happens!
t3: Now let us see Monkey's part. (pause) Monkey hangs his part on a tree. (pause) But it has no roots. (pause) It dries up. (pause) It does not grow at all.
t4: And what about Turtle's part? (pause) But Turtle's plant grows tall. (pause) It grows yellow bananas! (pause) Turtle is kind. (pause) Turtle is patient. (pause) That is why she has bananas.
t-check: That is the end of the story. Let us think about it. (pause) Let us think about the story.
t-check-q1-yes: Yes! Turtle was kind and patient. (pause) And she got bananas!
p1: Turtle was kind and patient. Now, here is a girl who was not helpful. (pause) Here is another story. (pause) The Legend of the Pineapple. (pause) Long ago, there was a girl named Pina. (pause) Pina did not like to help her mother.
p2a: Let us see what Pina does at home. (pause) One day, her mother is sick. (pause) Please cook for us, Pina, she says. (pause) But Pina says, I cannot find the pot! (pause) I cannot find the spoon! (pause) She does not even look.
p-mid: Hmm. The pot was right behind her! (pause) Quick question!
p-mid-q1: Did Pina really look for the pot?
p-mid-q1-yes: Right! Pina did not look. (pause) The pot was right there!
p3: Mother is sad and tired. (pause) Her mother is very tired. (pause) She says, I wish you had many eyes, (pause) so you can find things!
p4: What happens to Pina? (pause) The next day, Pina is gone. (pause) In the garden, a new plant grows. (pause) Its fruit has many, many eyes! (pause) It is the pineapple. (pause) The pinya!
p-check: Two stories, two lessons. Let us think! (pause) What does the story teach us?
p-check-q1: What should we do at home?
p-check-q1-yes: Yes! We help at home. (pause) Every little help is a big help!
verse: Turtle was kind. We help at home. The Bible tells us why. (pause) Our Bible verse is, (pause) Honor your father and your mother. (pause) We honor them when we help at home.
verse-verse: Honor your father and your mother. (pause) Exodus twenty, verse twelve.
done: You sang, you moved, and you listened! (pause) Hooray! (pause) You sang Bahay Kubo. (pause) You moved your body. (pause) And you listened to two stories. (pause) See you tomorrow!
